text: This is to advise that the report "2019 Education Property Tax Levy and Clawback Rate By-law" will be on the agenda of the Executive Committee meeting on April 9, 2019. The report is predicated on the Ministry of Finance making the Regulation, prescribing the tax rates for school purposes for the 2019 taxation year.

City Council on April 16 and 17, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the 2019 tax rates for school purposes, as shown in column II, which will raise an education tax levy on rateable properties for 2019 of $2,242,074,103, in accordance with O.Reg. 400/98 as amended, prescribing such rates for the City of Toronto: Column I Column II Property Class 2019 Tax Rates for Education Levy Residential 0.161000% Multi-Residential 0.161000% New Multi-Residential 0.161000% Commercial 1.030000% Commercial (New Construction) 1.030000% Commercial Residual 1.030000% Commercial Residual l (New Construction) 1.030000% Industrial 1.110878% Industrial (New Construction) 1.030000% Pipelines 1.290000% Farmlands 0.040250% Managed Forests 0.040250% 2.
